name: Mail And Content Protect – Restrict Access and Block Copying
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Mail And Content Protect is a robust plugin designed to safeguard your emails and content from spam and unauthorized access. With customizable options, you can tailor the protection measures to suit your specific needs.

Features

  • There are four content types: Content, Email, Phone Number, and URL.
  • You can set typography and color for secure values.

How to use

  • First, install the Mail And Content Protect plugin
  • Add the Mail And Content Protect block from the block category called “Widgets” in Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

Feedback

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Mail And Content Protect
  3. Click on the Mail And Content Protect to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the mail-and-content-protect plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the mail-and-content-protect.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Mail And Content Protect plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Mail And Content Protect free?

Yes, Mail And Content Protect is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
